scoring_justification: The main result is the presence of specific reciprocal-space peaks indicating 1T CDW modulation on the 1H layer. Absolute LDOS values are not comparable across DFT implementations, so we audit the structural pattern (T3). T1 recompute of a single numeric metric is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected CDW reciprocal lattice vectors and tolerance parameters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the known crystallography of (√13×√13)R13.9° superstructure of 1T-TaS2 with lattice constant a=3.316 Å as reported in literature (Wilson, Adv. Phys. 1969; Fazekas, Philos. Mag. B 1979).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed from atomic lattice reciprocal vectors b1, b2 and supercell transformation: A* = (4b1 - b2)/13, B* = (b1 + 3b2)/13.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These vectors are deterministic fixed numbers from the well-established crystallography of the CDW phase; they are not random.

outputs.description: Real-space local density of states integrated from EF to EF+200 meV on a plane 1.5 Å above the outer S atoms of the 1H layer. The checker computes its 2D Fourier transform and verifies the presence of peaks at the reciprocal lattice vectors of the (√13×√13)R13.9° superstructure, confirming the CDW transparency effect.

output_contract.notes: The checker performs a structural audit (T3) using 2D FFT to detect peaks at the expected CDW reciprocal lattice vectors. No absolute numeric value is compared; scoring is based on the presence and relative amplitude of those peaks. The raw energy positions of the Hubbard bands are not scored, only the LDOS periodicity.

steps.description: Validate that the 2D FFT of the LDOS grid contains peaks at the reciprocal lattice vectors of the (√13×√13)R13.9° CDW superstructure, with amplitude at least 5% of the strongest non-DC peak.
